description.value: The Deluxe Chinese Restaurant is the first North American location of the Deluxe Restaurant Group, which operates a number of restaurants in China. The restaurant occupies approximately 600 square metres and offers Cantonese dim sum, Sichuan dishes, and a Japanese sashimi bar — an unusual fusion for a Richmond dim sum house. Five private VIP rooms seating 16–40 guests make it a destination for group dining.
